When the conversation `front-gate` enters `jailed`, every member its arrest took who is still in the run and still held is set down on a free cell of Cells (region-cells), without walking the way between, and is told `The guards march you to the cells.`. 5 rounds pass on the world clock with it, and creatures due in them act. Whoever saw a member leave is told they were taken away, never where; whoever sees them arrive is told they arrived, never from where. The carriers who are up come to hold `jailed` about each of them. A taken member who has left the run is not moved and becomes wanted. Nobody is held by the jail itself: the cell's walls and door hold them, and a member may pick the door and walk out. When one of the conversation's carriers who holds `arrested` about a jailed member sees them outside Cells (region-cells), the carrier's faction's mind learns `prisoners-escaped`. If there are not enough free cells, or nobody to take, the line that leads here is refused.
